integrity: Ordinary geometric quotient; equivariant two-skeleton model from cited prior work. Finite chain checks corroborate but do not prove unrestricted result.
scientific_limitations: The complete homotopy type is asserted at width six only; for other nonfree widths the theorem determines integral homology and fundamental group, not all homotopy invariants. An equivalent unindexed result could affect priority.
title: Cyclic isotropy and integral topology of two-subset Kneser independence quotients
